name: P523 native packaging and signing preparation checks on committed source (2026-09-22 rerun)
summary: P523 preparation rerun on committed source: the 42 papercusp-desktop native Node test files whose names match release, sign, sidecar, windows, mac, install, provenance, tauri-config, seed, bundle or inno all passed: 538 tests, 538 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo, exit 0. The run was repeated because a peer change to bin/release-local.sh and test/release-local-linux-reuse.test.js was committed (desktop 5fd0b270) after the 22:42Z run. That change added 3 tests, which this run includes. The tests cover packaging-source behavior using source inspection, temporary fixture repositories and artifacts, and mocked install transports. This is NOT a full installer build, public signing, notarization, real-machine installation, P-521 physical acceptance, or a release-candidate test.

assertions.evidence: The run wrote EXIT=0. The TAP output ended with 1..538, tests 538, pass 538, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0, duration_ms 143299.151628. grep counted 538 'ok' lines and 0 'not ok' lines.

The 80 declared paths (42 native test files, 6 operator release test files, and the P523 packaging/signing source files) were SHA-256 manifested before and after the run, and the manifests were byte-identical. git status over those paths was empty at start. Superproject head c1cd32525dbf019850ecb8999542f3296f3124e6 and papercusp-desktop head 5fd0b270feb8998274d9258909bbfc7c0256b968 were identical before and after the run.

183 of the 538 passing tests have refusal-shaped names (refuse, reject, FAIL, corrupt, absent, invalid, missing, denies, block), 159 of these map by exact name to 35 of the 42 files, and 24 have generated names that could not be mapped to a single file; the largest counts are release-local-linux-reuse 22, sidecar-freshness-guard 18, release-identity-scan-archives 14, windows-source-repair 12, provenance-sidecar-record 9, and install-and-relaunch-verify 8. This is a name-based count, not a mutation proof.
TAP ok 48 - refuses to publish a deb when its updater signature is missing. TAP ok 49 - refuses to publish either final path when the staged signature is invalid.

TAP ok 71 - loads the conventional mode-0600 updater key when no signing env is supplied. TAP ok 72 - honors TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH instead of the conventional path. TAP ok 75 - signing-key preflight runs before seed staging and the expensive build.

TAP ok 67 - FAILS when db-sql/ has zero migration files. TAP ok 180 - compatibility requires extraction, intact bytes, and corruption refusal. TAP ok 186 - a passing installed update writes a tag-scoped receipt bound to provenance bytes. TAP ok 188 - Windows refuses a provenance-listed Server span when any disk is absent. TAP ok 205 - macOS refuses a GUI-only transition when the matching Server DMG is absent.

TAP ok 150 - the sidecar provenance receives the immutable build SHA and version. TAP ok 151 - vm-release sidecar reuse rejects provenance that differs from the launcher build SHA. TAP ok 233 - verify-provenance gates build-start dirt, not later cutter mutations. TAP ok 234 - verify-provenance rejects missing or non-boolean gitDirty attestations. TAP ok 235 - verify-provenance rejects missing or malformed release identity.
